question: Guru Gopinath National Award 2021 was honoured to whom among the following Kathak dancers?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kumudini Lakhia**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kumudini Lakhia:-**

 
 
• She is a renowned Kathak dancer and choreographer from India who has been awarded several other prestigious awards in the past.
 
• She was honored with the Guru Gopinath National Award 2021 for her contribution to the field of Kathak dance.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Durga Lal:-**

 
 
• He was a famous Kathak dancer and choreographer from Rajasthan who passed away in 1990.
 
• He is known for his contribution to the Jaipur Gharana of Kathak dance.
 
 
 
• **Roshan Kumari:-**
 
 
• She is a Kathak dancer from Jammu and Kashmir who has been trained in the Lucknow Gharana of Kathak dance.
 
 
 
• **Shambhu Maharaj:-**
 
 
• He was a legendary Kathak dancer from Lucknow who passed away in 1970. He was a part of the Maharaj family of Kathak dancers and is known for his contribution to the Lucknow Gharana of Kathak dance.
